{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bjornsons''' were a family of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]]. When [[Ariq Joanson]] attempted to establish peace with the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tuskens]] and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], they opposed him, as Tuskens had killed their son.
